research.facts:
Ferrari ADUO-2 Engine Confirmed for Monza
**Decision:** NEW STORY
**Sources:**
1. ScuderiaFans.com: "Fred Vasseur confirms Ferrari ADUO-2 power unit upgrade for Monza" — scuderiafans.com
2. ScuderiaFans.com: "Ferrari Monza upgrades explained: ADUO-2 engine, floor and aero changes" — scuderiafans.com
3. Yahoo Sports: "Ferrari's ADUO 2 Engine Upgrade at Monza Could Break the 2026 F1 Season" — sports.yahoo.com
4. Sky Sports: "Italian GP: Lewis Hamilton hopeful Ferrari can fight for Monza win as team confirm engine upgrade" — skysports.com
5. Crash.net: "Ferrari makes crucial upgraded F1 engine decision for Italian GP" — crash.net
**Key Facts (Verified):**
- ADUO-2 confirmed for Monza by Fred Vasseur (HIGH — multiple sources, Vasseur direct)
- Estimated +15 horsepower gain (MEDIUM — scuderiafans estimate, not official figure)
- Redesigned turbocharger: larger turbo, new compressor (HIGH — scuderiafans technical)
- No new Shell fuel blend with ADUO-2 unlike ADUO-1 (MEDIUM — scuderiafans)
- Both Hamilton and Leclerc receive ADUO-2 without grid penalty (HIGH — multiple sources confirm within allocation)
- Ferrari "severely hamstrung" by power deficit on straights (HIGH — acknowledged in multiple reports)
- Hamilton "hopeful Ferrari can fight for win" at Monza (HIGH — Sky Sports direct quote)
- ADUO-2 includes floor and aero changes alongside engine (MEDIUM — scuderiafans)
- Software update also included (MEDIUM — scuderiafans)
**Freshness:** Confirmed September 1-3 ahead of FP1 Sept 4. Very fresh.
**Why it matters:** Ferrari's engine deficit has been the story of 2026. This upgrade is their biggest power step of the year — at their home race — potentially changing the competitive order. Hamilton + Leclerc on new engine without penalty is massive.
